How can incoming customer messages be assigned to the right team member?

Set assignment rules in Noxtill based on skills, availability and message type. New messages go to the matching team member automatically, so customer support conversation assignment stays consistent, and Noxtill works as shared inbox team collaboration software where everyone sees who owns each conversation.
How does Team Assignment software help a small business, and what should buyers evaluate?

Messages reach the person best placed to answer, so responses are faster and nothing is left unowned. When comparing an inbox conversation assignment tool or team message routing software, check how you assign customer messages to agents (skills, availability, rules), reassignment, workload visibility and reporting.
